title: Tenma Saki — Hard-Knock Meeting〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: White Day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, our cards are all set!
Now we just need to hand them out!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope they like what we made♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too! Oh, but...
Are Minori and the others at school today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just saw Minori in the corridor!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku and Momoi should also be here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But the four of them usually meet up after school to do stuff, so you might not want to wait to hand them your cards.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. That means I've gotta get a move on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Have you already given your big sister her card, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I plan on giving it to her after I get home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, that means we're in the same boat!
I'm gonna give my card to Tsukasa after he gets home!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me three!
I hope we all get a chance to give out the cards we made to everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
For now, let's start by heading over to Minori's class!
A few hours later
Tenma Household

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Exchanging cards in SEKAI was so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm glad everyone liked the messages I wrote... Now I can't wait to give Mom and everyone their cards too.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I hope everyone gets home soon!)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I'm back.
Oh, Saki, you're home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Mom, welcome back!
Are you gonna start making dinner now?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I just got in the door, you know.
I was thinking about having some tea first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll make you some.
You sit tight and take a load off!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: You will? Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here you are♪ It's very hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you. Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Mom, there's something I wanna give you.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you have something for me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! I made you a card with a special message♪

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you. I don't know what to say...
Hehe. You made it so a bouquet of flowers pops out when you open it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's White Day, so I want to take this opportunity to show just how much I appreciate you♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I made the flowers for this bouquet using stickers. They're all your favorite kinds!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. They're lovely.
Is it alright if I read your message?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, wait! I wanna read it to you myself!
Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Thank you for being such an amazing person. Between your job and taking care of the house, I know you lead a very busy life.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I also know that I'm able to try new things and have fun because you work so hard to support me.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “So, moving forward, I promise to help you as much as I possibly can!”

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: But seeing you do what you like is enough to put a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That makes me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back!!
se_walk_men_005_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, welcome back! Your timing couldn't have been better!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here, Tsukasa! This is for you♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I made you a card with a special message for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're trying to become a world-famous star, so I decided to make a starry sky out of rhinestones♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, this is beautiful...! I like this deep blue card you chose. It makes these stars look all the more real!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even snuck in the Pegasus constellation amongst these stars!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! I never would've guessed...
But I should expect nothing less of my little sister! You came up with a wonderful design!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to read you the message I wrote!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I think you're the coolest person in the world because you're always doing everything you can to make your dream of becoming a star a reality.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “You keep finding new ways to amaze me, and I feel inspired every time to also chase after my dream♪”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Things might get hard from time to time, but I'll always be rooting for you. So, let's both keep doing our best to make our dreams come true!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What a beautiful message!
I'm so happy... M-My eyes...! I can't hold back these tears! That was so unbelievably moving!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm also constantly encouraged by your cheerful demeanor and willingness to help others! You are without a doubt the best little sister in the whole wide world!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. But I am glad that he likes it so much.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, that just leaves Dad♪
I hope he gets home soon.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: He just sent me a message saying that he's very close.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Then, I'll help make dinner in the meantime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna make it so he can start eating the second he gets home!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, I'll also lend a hand!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
Let's surprise Dad by making him the best dinner ever!
